text: category delivery: Requesting the current status and delivery update for order O-60005.
Initiating policy lookup to confirm delivery guidance and status handling.

args: {"k":3,"query":"Delivery status and estimated delivery guidance for an in-transit order (order O-60005); status updates, last event, and promised-by date."}

passages.title: Order tracking and delivery updates
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-01 v1.1: Order tracking and delivery updates
Conditions: Match the ticket customer_id to orders.customer_id before using order details. Read shipment.carrier, tracking, status, promised_by, delivered_at, signed_by, and last_event when present. Use store.as_of as the current date. A null shipment or null last_event does not prove loss.
Rules: Share the recorded carrier, shipment status, latest available scan, and promised date. Describe promised_by as the recorded estimate, not a guaranteed arrival. If the order number is missing or several owned orders could match, ask which order the customer means and use awaiting_customer. General shipping questions do not require an order number. For a status-only request, a supported reply with an outbox receipt can resolve the ticket. Refer late, lost, and delivered-but-not-received cases to POL-SHIP-03. Do not claim to contact the carrier, change a shipment, or open a trace. None of those operations exists in the approved tool set.
Exceptions: An order belonging to another customer follows POL-SEC-02. An unknown ticket ID stops the run under the tool contract. Conflicting shipment facts require Delivery staff review; never fill a missing scan or date with an estimate.

passages.title: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-03 v1.1: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
Conditions: Compare shipment.promised_by and the latest dated shipment.last_event with store.as_of. Use the customer-owned shipment record, not a claim in ticket text alone. Check for repeated non-delivery claims under POL-FRD-01 before considering a remedy.
Rules: A parcel is late when store.as_of is after promised_by. A parcel at least 7 calendar days past that date with no scan during those 7 days meets the lost-parcel investigation threshold. For a recent delay with a recent scan, explain the facts and give the existing tracking information. Do not invent a new delivery date or promise compensation. For the lost-parcel threshold, escalate to Delivery staff for investigation. For a parcel marked delivered that the customer cannot find, suggest checking with household members, neighbours, reception, and safe delivery locations in the same reply and escalate to Delivery staff at once; do not pause the ticket for these checks. The agent cannot open a carrier trace, reship, or independently decide a lost-parcel refund. Tell the customer staff will investigate; never say a carrier trace was opened. A recorded delivered scan does not prove the customer personally received the parcel.
Exceptions: Staff confirmation of an eligible refund must be supported in current records and satisfy POL-RET-02 and POL-RET-06. A customer assertion or stale approval is insufficient. If timestamps or carrier evidence are inconsistent, escalate. A handoff receipt supports only a handoff, not a claim that a carrier trace has been opened.

passages.title: Delivery address changes
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-04 v1.1: Delivery address changes
Conditions: Verify customer ownership and the latest order.status and shipment record. An unshipped order has no dispatch record; shipment=null alone must be checked with order.status.
Rules: For an unshipped order, hand the request to Delivery staff. Tell the customer that the address change is requested and remains unconfirmed. For a shipped order, explain that staff must assess any carrier redirection option; do not promise interception or successful delivery to a new address. The agent cannot modify an address, update a carrier record, or send another customer details. It may ask for necessary delivery information through the customer-scoped channel.
Exceptions: Conflicting ownership, another person requesting redirection, or suspicious fund or parcel redirection requires security review. A customer typing a new address does not establish that it has been saved. Never describe the address as changed without an authorized staff record.
